archiver.archive.title: This archiver
archiver.archive.help: The device keeps signed packets for the network and answers whoever asks for them. It does so under its own station callsign.
archiver.keep.title: What it keeps
archiver.keep.followed.help: Their packets stay while you follow them
archiver.keep.public.help: Keep strangers' packets too, and announce serve:archive
archiver.serve.title: Serving others
archiver.serve.always_on.help: Larger budgets, several askers at once, release mirror
archiver.serve.room.help: Off announces room:no, so newcomers choose another archiver
archiver.files.title: Files kept for others
archiver.files.help: Pictures and files this device hosts for people who fetch them
archiver.files.free.help: Deletes what is held for others ({n})
archiver.files.free.confirm.body: Files kept for other people are deleted. Your own are not.
archiver.dir.title: Who has this?
archiver.dir.help: Answers where a file can be found, for devices that ask
archiver.mine.title: Archivers I rely on
archiver.mine.help: They keep copies of your messages and hold your mail while you are away
archiver.mine.auto.help: When none is listed, adopt a public archiver in reach
archiver.mine.search: Add an archiver: search a station
